_comment: The lesson map of Al-Fatihah (operator 2026-10-13, docs/belajar-plan.md L23: 'at the beginning of the ayat, better to inform what concept we will learn in this ayat … in the end recap what we've learnt'; 'if some concept already done in previous ayat, we say we repeat what we've learnt before' — and L26, the basic curriculum: 'separate new vs already knows concept, this is what new, this is what we've learnt so far'). THIS FILE IS THE PER-SURAH SWITCH: a surah that has authored/<slug>.map.json gets content/map/<slug>.json (build_map.py), its map and learned narration lines per ayah (':map:new', ':map:learnt', ':map:later' after the imam's recitation, ':learned' before the recap; build_narration.py) and their card on the stage; a surah without it gets none of these. What is new, learnt so far, taught later and next-level in an ayah is never typed here: it is the curriculum's (authored/curriculum.json -> content/curriculum.json, lessonmap.py). A surah may be switched on only when every step taught in it has a text and every step its map lists has a name the narrator can say (validate_curriculum.py check 7). `names`: next-level Konsep record id -> an explicit short name (prose, at most four words, no Qur'anic word), ONLY for a record whose Konsep title opens with no clean name; build_map.py stops and names the record when one is needed. Al-Fatihah needs none: each of its nine next-level records is named as its title opens. (Until 2026-10-13 this file also had `later`, an authored item an ayah shows without teaching: marfu' in ayah 1. Superseded: marfu' is a step of the curriculum, taught in ayah 2 and found wherever a word is marfu'. The sentence that points ahead in ayah 1, 'Mengapa dhammah, kita pelajari di ayat kedua.' (1:w1:compose:3), stays and stays true.)
